meaning:
ἀντι-πίπτω
[in LXX: Exo.26:5 (קָבַל), Exo.26:17 (שׁוּב), Num.27:14 (מְרִיבָה) Job.23:13 (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;]
1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, Act.7:51
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
